claims.statement: The source code is licensed under the MIT license.

claims.quote: [![github-tests-badge](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/SinTan1729/chhoto-url/.github%2Fworkflows%2Frust-tests.yml?logo=github&label=tests)](https://github.com/SinTan1729/chhoto-url/actions/workflows/rust-tests.yml)
claims.statement: The project has an automated test workflow (rust-tests.yml) that runs on GitHub Actions.

claims.quote: [![latest-release-badge](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/SinTan1729/chhoto-url?logo=github)](https://github.com/SinTan1729/chhoto-url/releases/latest)
claims.statement: A latest release version of chhoto-url is published on GitHub.

claims.quote: A simple selfhosted URL shortener with no unnecessary features
claims.statement: The target is a self-hosted URL shortener whose core function works, with a deliberately minimal feature set.

claims.quote: Simplicity and speed are the main foci of this project.
claims.statement: The project's stated design priorities are simplicity and speed — a statement of focus rather than a testable performance figure on its own.

claims.quote: The scratch docker image is <4.5 MB (compressed)
claims.statement: The scratch-variant Docker image, compressed, is smaller than 4.5 MB.

claims.quote: the alpine one is <8.5 MB (compressed)
claims.statement: The alpine-variant Docker image, compressed, is smaller than 8.5 MB.

claims.quote: it uses <10 MB of RAM under regular use
claims.statement: The application consumes less than 10 MB of RAM under normal operation.

claims.quote:
I consider this project
to be complete, not dead. I'm unlikely to add any new features, but I will try
and fix every bug you report. I will also try to keep it updated in terms of
security vulnerabilities.
claims.statement: The seller states the project is in maintenance mode: no new features planned, with reported bugs fixed and security updates applied — a statement about the seller's ongoing activity and intent, which the supplied materials are not expected to reach.

claims.quote:
So, I decided
to rewrite it in Rust and add some features to it that I thought were essential (e.g. hit counting).
claims.statement: The target is implemented in Rust (a rewrite of simply-shorten) and includes features such as hit counting.

claims.quote: The database is cleared every 15 minutes, so don't use it for anything other than testing.
claims.statement: The seller's hosted demo instance wipes its database every 15 minutes.

claims.quote: Shortens URLs of any length to a randomly generated link.
claims.statement: The tool shortens URLs of any length, generating a random short link.

claims.quote: Automatic expiry of links after a chosen time.
claims.statement: Links can be given a chosen expiry time after which they expire automatically.

claims.quote:
(Optional) Allows you to specify the shortened URL instead of the generated
  one.
claims.statement: Optionally, the user can choose a custom short URL instead of the randomly generated one.

claims.quote:
Opening the shortened URL in your browser will instantly redirect you
  to the correct long URL.
claims.statement: Visiting a short URL redirects immediately to the original long URL, with no intermediate redirection page.

claims.quote: The docker image is only ~6MB
claims.statement: The Docker image is approximately 6MB in size.

claims.quote:
RAM uasge
  stays under 5MB under normal use.
claims.statement: RAM usage stays under 5MB under normal use.

claims.quote: Counts number of hits for each short link
claims.statement: The tool counts the number of hits for each short link.

claims.quote:
in a privacy respecting way
  i.e. only the hit is recorded, and nothing else.
claims.statement: Hit counting is privacy respecting: only the fact of the hit is recorded, and no other data (e.g. IPs, user agents) is stored.

claims.quote: Short links can be edited after creation.
claims.statement: Existing short links can be edited after they are created.

claims.quote: Each short link may have custom notes attached to it.
claims.statement: Custom notes can be attached to each short link.

claims.quote:
The UI features filtering for links,
  based on short link, long link, and notes.
claims.statement: The user interface supports filtering links by short link, long link, and notes.

claims.quote: QR codes can be generated for easy sharing.
claims.statement: The tool can generate QR codes for short links.

claims.quote: Supports operation using API key, and lets the user provide hashed password and API key.
claims.statement: The tool supports operation via an API key, and the user can supply the password and API key in hashed form.

claims.quote: Has a robust JSON-RPC adjacent API.
claims.statement: The tool exposes a programmatic API described as JSON-RPC adjacent.

claims.quote: Has a mobile friendly UI
claims.statement: The user interface is mobile friendly.

claims.quote: automatic dark mode
claims.statement: The UI switches to dark mode automatically.

claims.quote: Can serve a custom landing page, if needed.
claims.statement: The tool can serve a custom landing page when configured to do so.

claims.quote:
Has a public mode, where anyone can add links without authentication. Deleting
  or listing available links will need admin access using the password.
claims.statement: A public mode exists in which anyone can add links without authenticating, while deleting or listing links requires admin access with the password.

claims.quote: It's also possible to completely disable the frontend.
claims.statement: The frontend can be completely disabled by configuration.

claims.quote:
It's also possible to force an expiry
  time for public instances, which might be useful.
claims.statement: An expiry time can be forced for links added on public instances.

claims.quote:
Allows setting the URL of your website, in case you want to conveniently
  generate short links locally.
claims.statement: The site URL is configurable, so short links can be generated against the user's own domain.

claims.quote: Links are stored in an SQLite database, which is configured to be ACID by default.
claims.statement: Links are persisted in an SQLite database, and that database is configured for ACID behaviour by default.

claims.quote: Options are available for tuning the database to the user's liking.
claims.statement: Configuration options exist for tuning the database.

claims.quote: Available as a Docker container with a provided compose file.
claims.statement: The tool is distributed as a Docker container, and a compose file is provided in the materials.

claims.quote:
Backend written in Rust using [Actix Web](https://actix.rs/), and frontend
  written in plain HTML and vanilla JS, using [Pure CSS](https://purecss.io/)
  for styling.
claims.statement: The backend is written in Rust using Actix Web, and the frontend is plain HTML and vanilla JavaScript styled with Pure CSS.

claims.quote: Uses very basic authentication using a provided password. It's not encrypted in transport.
claims.statement: Authentication uses a provided password in a very basic form, and that authentication is not encrypted in transport.

claims.quote: **Tracking or spying of any kind.**
claims.statement: The seller states that tracking or spying functionality will not be implemented in the project.

claims.quote:
The only logs that still exist are
  some very simple ones, mostly meant for debugging.
claims.statement: The only logging the software performs is a small set of simple logs intended mostly for debugging.

claims.quote: **User management.**
claims.statement: The seller states that user management will not be implemented, and that organizations needing one should run separate containers or use other software.

claims.quote:
**Cookies, newsletters**, "we value your privacy" popups or any of the multiple
  other ways modern web shows how anti-user it is.
claims.statement: The seller states that cookies, newsletters and consent popups will not be implemented in the project.

claims.quote: **Paywalls** or messages begging for donations.
claims.statement: The seller states that paywalls or donation-request messages will not be implemented in the project.

claims.quote:
The list of adjectives and names used for random short url generation is a modified
  version of [this list used by docker](https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/master/internal/namesgenerator/names-generator.go).
claims.statement: The word list used for random short URL generation is a modified version of the Docker/moby names-generator list.

claims.quote: It is highly recommended that you [enable WAL mode](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_sqlite_use_wal_mode).
claims.statement: The software supports enabling SQLite WAL mode through a documented configuration option.

claims.quote: Although it's unlikely, it's possible that your database is mangled after some update.
claims.statement: The seller discloses that applying some update may, in rare cases, corrupt or mangle the database.

claims.quote:
If you intend to have more than a few thousand short links, it's strongly recommended that you use the UID
  [`CHHOTO_SLUG_STYLE`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_style) with a [`CHHOTO_SLUG_LENGTH`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_slug_length)
  of 16 or more.
claims.statement: The software provides the configuration options CHHOTO_SLUG_STYLE and CHHOTO_SLUG_LENGTH.

claims.quote: Otherwise, generating new links will start to fail after a while.
claims.statement: With the default slug generation, creating new links will begin to fail once the number of links exceeds a few thousand.

claims.quote:
For safety, only `https`,`http`,`ftp`, and `magnet` links are allowed for long links by default. Please take a look at
  [`CHHOTO_EXTRA_PROTOCOLS`](./docs/INSTALLATION.md#chhoto_extra_protocols) to use more protocols.
claims.statement: By default only https, http, ftp and magnet protocols are accepted for long links, and the CHHOTO_EXTRA_PROTOCOLS option can extend this allowlist.

claims.quote: A simple selfhosted URL shortener with no unnecessary features
claims.statement: The target can be self-hosted: it runs entirely on infrastructure the user controls, without requiring the seller's hosted service.
